The correct response is not to appeal, not to find a workaround, and not to use a friend's account in another country. The correct response is to build [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products|infrastructure]] that does not depend on their permission to operate. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal offer quick payment processing and user-friendly interfaces, but they do so by limiting access to only 46 countries. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH, allows creators in excluded regions to deploy a fully operational online store. This setup includes automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery, ensuring creators retain full control over their sales without dependence on traditional payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal effectively lock out creators from many countries, which limits their ability to monetize digital products. For instance, PayPal can suspend accounts, holding funds for up to 180 days without recourse. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure eliminates these barriers, offering a seamless solution for creators. With options like NOWPayments, creators can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that they are not restricted by geographic limitations or platform policies.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal may offer fast payment processing, but their fees can accumulate, and the risk of account suspension adds hidden costs. In contrast, NOWPayments charges just a 0.5% fee for processing payments, with minimal transaction costs on recommended networks like BSC and Solana. This makes it a financially viable choice for creators, as they can keep more of their earnings while enjoying prompt payment confirmation through automatic webhooks.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures you own your data and sales process completely.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Using traditional platforms often means renting access to services and losing ownership of customer data. In stark contrast, with the Edge Commerce Stack, creators fully own their infrastructure after deployment. The automated delivery of products through solutions like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensures an efficient process without relying on third-party platforms. This architecture provides not only autonomy over sales but also peace of mind regarding data ownership.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right digital commerce architecture depends on your specific needs. If you require a quick setup and plan to sell a limited number of products, the Sovereign Starter Stack may suffice. For those looking for more robust features and scalability, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal. It allows for five products and is deployed in just 48 hours, ensuring that you're operational without the constraints posed by traditional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid the risk of account suspensions and payment holds with traditional platforms.

Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
